calibration_notes: Debit-dispute liability (082, 084-087): the severities are consistent and the reasons are stated. Major for 082/085/086 (discovery-timed vs statement-timed tiers), Blocker for 084 (no single cap rule reproduces 50 for $47.50 and 412.88 for $412.88), and a note-only stated reason for 087. Underlying pattern across golds: current-cycle (November) transactions get $50, October transactions get the $500 tier, and only the $500 tier is capped at the disputed amount (084: 412.88; 086: 625 -> 500; 085: 14.99 -> 50 uncapped). Reports should name the cap asymmetry as the deciding defect.

Provisional-credit flags (082-086): Major everywhere, consistent. Gold pattern: duplicates with contacted_merchant false -> true (083/084/085) while yes_shared -> false (082/083). The gold applies doc_032 NOT-REQUIRED item 3 but not item 2. NOT-REQUIRED categories are false (083/084/085/086) except 082 FitLife (recurring_charge_after_cancellation, contacted) -> true.

Unscripted replacement shipping speed: 082 rates it Major (part of a combined issue), while sibling task_092 (outside this group) rates an unscripted Mid-tier STANDARD/CLASSIC replacement Minor on the reasoning that those are 'the only free choices'. doc_023 labels only CLASSIC as '(default, no fee)' and gives no delivery default, so under calibration the unscripted speed is Major in both, or 092 needs a stated reason. 092 looks under-rated.

methodology_note: The review's grading model and scorer facts are accurate. I confirmed each against the snapshot code and the working-repo _verified_db_match, and my copied-scorer replays matched every 'Replay:' claim I tested (about 45 alternatives across the 20 tasks; gold self-matched in all). Citations are accurate: I found no fabricated quotes, paths or values, and the one problem is the 101 misreading of a correctly quoted FAQ. The main blind spot is cross-task consistency within a defect class. Reviewers judged each task against its own gold, so asymmetric pairs slipped through: 093/097 (same relationship-bonus readings, different severities), 101/102 (window wording rated Minor despite a supporting FAQ clause), and 091 vs 086/087 (contradictory golds for the same tier request), plus the 082 vs 092 shipping-default split. Comparing sibling golds turned out to be the strongest evidence for the Blocker calls (091, 084), and the review used it only partly. No finding in this group depends on the verified scorer's relaxations: every divergence tested fails both verified and exact comparison.
